name: date-sanity-input
title: Date Sanity Input
description: Reads the weekday back and catches year typos, past or future dates on the wrong side of today (per `expect`), dates implausibly far away and weekends, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.summary: Reads a date back with its weekday and catches year typos, dates on the wrong side of today and weekends, so bookings aren't made for the wrong day.
catches: A past date where a future one is expected, or the reverse
Dates more than maxYearsAway from today
The weekday, read back so the user can spot a wrong day
limits: Doesn't know holidays or business-specific closed days
"Today" is the visitor's clock unless you pass `today`
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" status
Fix returns focus to the input
